rules.name: Command Protocols
rules.lore: The tribal lords of the Ronnec make war in a cold and calculated fashion. Their commonds crackle out across the battlefield, compelling their warriors into battle, one step at a time.
rules.text: While leading a unit, your +Ronnec+ +Leader+ models and their attached +Bodyguard+ and +Support+ models have +1 to Hit rolls.

strategems.name: Emergency Recovery
strategems.target: One +Ronnec+ +Infantry+ +Character+ model from your army that was just destroyed.
strategems.effect: Set your model back up on the Battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and out of Melee Distance of enemy models, with half its starting Health remaining.
strategems.restriction: This strategem may not target a given model more than once per battle.

strategems.name: Portable Shield Matrix
strategems.when: After an enemy Unit has resolved a Shoot action
strategems.target: A friendly +Necrons+ unit in your army that had one or more of its models killed as a result of the attack.
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, enemy units attacking the target unit have -1 to Wound Rolls.

strategems.name: Servo Stabilization
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, your unit has +1 to its Hit Rolls.
